questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: take French law classes, I think it’s more interesting than picking int/eu law courses. More fun to learn something new and see the differences between the legal systems. Less useful in practice for most people tho, but good general knowledge. Recommend biens and pénal

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. You need to speak French 
2. Take interesting classes
3. Remember that you are not only there to study

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Classes are very different to those at ucph, keep in mind that it is not interactive style teaching

questions.answer: In the beginning the formal legal French
